hero.headline: All your recommendations - one link, one QR
hero.subtext: Used by explorers worldwide. One link for everything you recommend - places, guides, music and more.

createCustomize.headline: Create your Explorer page in minutes
createCustomize.subtext:
Collect everything you'd normally share across messages, notes, or conversations — and bring it together in one place.

Organize your recommendations by city, journey, theme, or moment, and update them anytime as your perspective evolves.

addSpots.title: Add places, experiences, routes, sounds, and notes

generate.title: Edit anytime — your link always stays the same

share.title: Share digitally or through a QR in the real world

shareAnywhere.headline: One link. Many journeys.
shareAnywhere.subtext:
Your Explorer link becomes a living guide — something people can save, revisit, and explore at their own pace.

Share it on a profile, message, table, wall, or card.
Wherever it goes, your perspective goes with it.

analytics.headline: Track clicks, referrals, and engagement
analytics.subtext: See what's working, who's scanning, and which places get the most love — in real time.

localTunes.title: Listen as you explore
localTunes.body:
Exploration isn't only visual. Sound carries memory, context, and emotion.

LocalTunes lets you collect and share soundtracks for places, journeys, and moods — whether it's music discovered on the road or sounds that define a place for you.

Seamlessly connected to your Explorer profile.

realtimeCollaboration.title: Real-time Collaboration
realtimeCollaboration.description: Let guests add songs to your playlist instantly while you maintain full control over what plays.

qrCodeSharing.title: QR Code Sharing
qrCodeSharing.description: Share your music experience with a simple QR code scan - no apps or downloads required.

youtubeIntegration.title: YouTube Integration
youtubeIntegration.description: Seamlessly integrate with YouTube to access millions of songs and create the perfect atmosphere.

voteLikeSystem.title: Vote & Like System
voteLikeSystem.description: Guests can vote for their favorite songs to influence the playlist queue in real-time.

silentParties.title: Silent Parties
silentParties.description: Host unique silent parties where everyone listens through their own headphones.

karaokeReady.title: Karaoke Ready
karaokeReady.description: Perfect for karaoke nights with collaborative playlists and real-time song requests.

localTunes.closingStatement: Tunes is free to explore, and for paid features you can upgrade afterwards.

referEarn.headline: Share, refer, and earn
referEarn.subtext: Turn your recommendations into passive rewards — get credit when others use your QR.

testimonials.subtext: See how people around the world use explorers to share what matters most.

items.name: Priya Sharma
items.quote: explorers transformed how I share my travel knowledge. My followers love getting instant access to my curated recommendations!

items.name: Raj Patel
items.quote: My guests absolutely love the personalized QR code in their welcome kit. It's become my signature touch!

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.quote: We share our explorers with customers to recommend other local spots. It's created amazing community connections.

items.name: Maria Silva
items.quote: explorers helps me extend my expertise beyond tour hours. Clients can access my recommendations anytime!

items.name: James Wilson
items.quote: As a travel influencer, explorers makes it so easy to share my favorite spots with my audience. The QR code feature is brilliant!

items.name: Sophie Martin
items.quote: I use explorers to create walking tours for my clients. They can scan the QR and explore at their own pace!

about.title: Explorers of Earth

subtitle.line1: A global community of people who explore with care — for people, culture, and the planet we share.
subtitle.line2: Exploration, for us, isn't about how far we go.
subtitle.line3: It's about how deeply we connect.

section1.title: WHAT WE BELIEVE
section1.line2: With noticing what others pass by.
section1.line3: With choosing to move thoughtfully, not quickly.
section1.line4:
We're living briefly on an ancient planet —
adding a few intentional marks to a story
that started long before us
and will continue long after we're gone.

section2.title: HOW WE SEE EXPLORATION
section2.line3:
It lives in slowing down, paying attention,
and respecting every place we step into —
a street, a mountain path, a café table,
or a moment shared with someone new.

section3.title: WHAT WE'RE BUILDING
section3.item2: Places, journeys, sounds, and stories worth remembering
section3.item3: Communities built on people — not popularity metrics

section4.title: BELONGING
section4.line1: Explorers of Earth isn't a club.
section4.line3:
It's a shared mindset —
a quiet understanding of how we move through the world.

about.closing:
If you're curious.
If you're thoughtful.
If you're willing to slow down and look closer —
you already belong here.
